_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Get a product's price history

description: Read how one product's price and availability moved over the days a store has been tracked. Use it for questions like "how has the price of this hoodie changed?", "when did this product go on sale?", "has this been out of stock?". It is most useful after check_store_prices has tracked the store: history starts on the first snapshot, so a store never read before has one day only. Calling it reads the store when there is no snapshot for today and adds it to the daily snapshot list. Pass the store's address and the product's link, handle or title; an exact handle or title wins over part of a title. Returns per variant the price, the compare-at (was) price and availability on each day something changed. Status ambiguous returns candidates: ask the user to pick one, then call again with that title. Not for a whole store's changes (use check_store_prices) or for comparing stores (use compare_store_prices).

product.description: The product, such as "Tree Runner" or "https://allbirds.com/products/mens-tree-runners". A link is read as its handle. An exact handle or title wins over part of a title; several partial matches come back as candidates.

store.description: Store web address, such as "allbirds.com": a bare host, an https link or a myshopify.com address

name: get_product_price_history

candidates.description: Product titles to choose from when status is ambiguous

firstSeen.description: Day the product was first seen, YYYY-MM-DD

available.description: True when at least one variant can be bought

compareAt.description: Compare-at (was) price in major units of the store's currency; null when the product is not on sale

price.description: Lowest and highest variant price in major units of the store's currency

type.description: Product type the store gives it

url.description: Link to the product page on the store

price.description: Major units of the store's currency

removedOn.description: Day the product left the store, YYYY-MM-DD; null while it is listed

current.description: Today's price and availability; null when the variant is gone

price.description: Major units of the store's currency

points.description: The first day seen, then one point per day the variant changed, oldest first

compareAt.description: Price in major units (such as 98.5) of the store's currency; null when unknown

price.description: Price in major units (such as 98.5) of the store's currency; null when unknown

removed.description: True on the day the variant was removed

message.description: What to tell the user, and the next step for a status other than ok

product.description: The product as the user wrote it

query.description: The store as the user wrote it

status.description: ambiguous: pick one of candidates and call again. not_found: ask for the product link. invalid or unavailable: relay message

title: Get a product's price history
